145: # Replace with YOUR domain (same as zone_name)
146: PREVIEW_HOSTNAME = "yourdomain.com"
147: # Pages project name for deployments
148: PAGES_PROJECT_NAME = "nimbus"
149: 
150: # D1 Database - replace database_id with yours from step 2
151: [[d1_databases]]
152: binding = "DB"
153: database_name = "nimbus-db"
154: database_id = "your-database-id-here"
155: 
156: # Sandbox container configuration
157: [[containers]]
158: class_name = "Sandbox"
159: image = "./Dockerfile"
160: 
161: [durable_objects]
162: bindings = [{ name = "Sandbox", class_name = "Sandbox" }]
163: 
164: [[migrations]]
165: tag = "v1"
166: new_sqlite_classes = ["Sandbox"]
167: ```
168: 
169: **Replace:**
170: - `yourdomain.com` with your actual domain (in both places)
171: - `database_id` with the ID from step 2
172: 
173: ### 6. Run Database Migrations
174: 
175: ```bash
176: cd packages/worker
177: pnpm exec wrangler d1 migrations apply nimbus-db --remote
178: ```
179: 
180: ### 7. Set Secrets
181: 
182: ```bash
183: cd packages/worker
184: 
185: # OpenRouter API key (for LLM access)
186: pnpm exec wrangler secret put OPENROUTER_API_KEY
187: # Paste your API key when prompted
188: 
189: # Cloudflare API token (for Pages deployment)
190: # Create at: https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens
191: # Required permission: Cloudflare Pages - Edit
192: pnpm exec wrangler secret put CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
193: 
194: # Cloudflare Account ID (find in dashboard URL or sidebar)
195: pnpm exec wrangler secret put CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
196: ```
197: 
198: ### 8. Deploy
199: 
200: Make sure Docker Desktop is running, then:
201: 
202: ```bash
203: cd packages/worker
204: pnpm exec wrangler deploy
205: ```
206: 
207: First deployment takes 2-3 minutes (builds the container image). You'll see output like:
208: 
209: ```
210: Uploaded nimbus-worker (8.45 sec)
211: Building image nimbus-worker-sandbox:abc123
212: ...
213: Deployed nimbus-worker triggers
214:   *.yourdomain.com/* (zone name: yourdomain.com)
215: ```
216: 
217: **Wait 2-3 minutes** after first deploy for the container to provision before testing.
218: 
219: ### 9. Test the Deployment
220: 
221: ```bash
222: # Health check
223: curl https://api.yourdomain.com/health
224: 
225: # Or any subdomain works since you have wildcard routing
226: curl https://anything.yourdomain.com/health
227: ```
228: 
229: ### 10. Use the CLI
230: 
231: ```bash
232: # Option 1: Inline
233: NIMBUS_WORKER_URL=https://api.yourdomain.com npx @dayhaysoos/nimbus start "Build a landing page"
234: 
235: # Option 2: Export for session
236: export NIMBUS_WORKER_URL=https://api.yourdomain.com
237: npx @dayhaysoos/nimbus start "Build a landing page"
238: 
239: # Option 3: Add to shell profile (~/.bashrc, ~/.zshrc, etc.)
240: echo 'export NIMBUS_WORKER_URL=https://api.yourdomain.com' >> ~/.zshrc
241: ```
242: 
243: ## Usage
244: 
245: ```bash
246: # Set your worker URL first
247: export NIMBUS_WORKER_URL=https://api.yourdomain.com
248: 
249: # Start a build (interactive model picker)
250: npx @dayhaysoos/nimbus start "Build a portfolio site for a photographer"
251: 
252: # Start with a specific model
253: npx @dayhaysoos/nimbus start -m anthropic/claude-sonnet-4 "Create a todo app"
254: 
255: # List your job history
256: npx @dayhaysoos/nimbus list
257: 
258: # Watch a job's progress
259: npx @dayhaysoos/nimbus watch job_abc12345
260: ```
261: 
262: The CLI will show progress and output URLs:
263: 
264: ```
265: ┌  @dayhaysoos/nimbus
266: │
267: ◇  Job created: job_abc12345
268: ◇  Generated 3 files
269: ◇  Build complete
270: ◇  Preview ready
271: │
272: ●  Preview: https://8080-build-abc123.yourdomain.com/
273: │
274: ◇  Done
275: │
276: └  Deployed: https://abc123.nimbus.pages.dev
277: ```
278: 
279: **Two URLs are provided:**
280: - **Preview URL** - Temporary, dies when sandbox times out (~10 min idle)
281: - **Deployed URL** - Permanent Cloudflare Pages URL
282: 
283: ## Project Structure
284: 
285: ```
286: nimbus/
287: ├── packages/
288: │   ├── cli/                    # @dayhaysoos/nimbus CLI
289: │   │   └── src/
290: │   │       ├── index.ts        # CLI entry + command router
291: │   │       ├── commands/       # start, list, watch commands
292: │   │       └── lib/            # API client, model picker, types
293: │   └── worker/                 # Cloudflare Worker
294: │       ├── src/
295: │       │   ├── index.ts        # API routes
296: │       │   ├── api/jobs.ts     # Job creation & SSE streaming
297: │       │   ├── openrouter.ts   # LLM client
298: │       │   ├── sandbox.ts      # Container orchestration
299: │       │   ├── lib/
300: │       │   │   ├── db.ts       # D1 database operations
301: │       │   │   └── deploy/     # Pages deployment
302: │       │   └── types.ts        # TypeScript types
303: │       ├── migrations/         # D1 database migrations
304: │       ├── wrangler.toml       # Cloudflare config
305: │       └── Dockerfile          # Sandbox container
306: ├── package.json                # Workspace root
307: └── pnpm-workspace.yaml
308: ```
309: 
310: ## Configuration Options
311: 
312: ### Environment Variables (wrangler.toml `[vars]`)
313: 
314: | Variable | Description | Default |
315: |----------|-------------|---------|
316: | `DEFAULT_MODEL` | OpenRouter model ID | `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4` |
317: | `PREVIEW_HOSTNAME` | Domain for preview URLs | (required) |
318: | `PAGES_PROJECT_NAME` | Cloudflare Pages project | `nimbus` |
319: 
320: ### Secrets (set via `wrangler secret put`)
321: 
322: | Secret | Description |
323: |--------|-------------|
324: | `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Your OpenRouter API key |
325: | `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` | Cloudflare API token with Pages Edit permission |
326: | `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID` | Your Cloudflare account ID |
327: 
328: ### Changing the LLM Model
329: 
330: You can select a model interactively when running `nimbus start`, or specify one with the `-m` flag:
331: 
332: ```bash
333: nimbus start -m openai/gpt-4o "Build a landing page"
334: ```
335: 
336: Available models include:
337: - `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4` (default)
338: - `anthropic/claude-opus-4`
339: - `openai/gpt-4o`
340: - `openai/gpt-4.1`
341: - `google/gemini-2.5-pro`
342: - `deepseek/deepseek-r1`
343: - `meta-llama/llama-4-maverick`
344: 
345: Or enter any model ID from [OpenRouter Models](https://openrouter.ai/models).
346: 
347: ## API Reference
348: 
349: ### `POST /api/jobs`
350: 
351: Creates a new job and streams SSE events while generating and building.
352: 
353: **Request:**
354: ```json
355: {
356:   "prompt": "Build a landing page for a SaaS product",
357:   "model": "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4"
358: }
359: ```
360: 
361: **SSE Events:**
362: ```
363: data: {"type":"job_created","jobId":"job_abc12345"}
364: data: {"type":"generating"}
365: data: {"type":"generated","fileCount":3}
366: data: {"type":"scaffolding"}
367: data: {"type":"writing"}
368: data: {"type":"installing"}
369: data: {"type":"building"}
370: data: {"type":"starting"}
371: data: {"type":"preview_ready","previewUrl":"https://8080-xxx.yourdomain.com/"}
372: data: {"type":"deploying"}
373: data: {"type":"complete","previewUrl":"...","deployedUrl":"https://xxx.nimbus.pages.dev"}
374: ```
375: 
376: ### `GET /api/jobs`
377: 
378: Lists all jobs.
379: 
380: **Response:**
381: ```json
382: {
383:   "jobs": [
384:     {
385:       "id": "job_abc12345",
386:       "prompt": "Build a landing page",
387:       "model": "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4",
388:       "status": "completed",
389:       "createdAt": "2025-01-22 12:00:00",
390:       "deployedUrl": "https://abc123.nimbus.pages.dev"
391:     }
392:   ]
393: }
394: ```
395: 
396: ### `GET /api/jobs/:id`
397: 
398: Gets a specific job's details.
399: 
400: ### `GET /health`
401: 
402: Returns `{"status":"ok"}` if the worker is running.
403: 
404: ## Troubleshooting
405: 
406: ### "OPENROUTER_API_KEY not configured"
407: 
408: ```bash
409: cd packages/worker
410: pnpm exec wrangler secret put OPENROUTER_API_KEY
411: ```
412: 
413: ### Pages deployment fails
414: 
415: Ensure you've set the Cloudflare secrets:
416: 
417: ```bash
418: pnpm exec wrangler secret put CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
419: pnpm exec wrangler secret put CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
420: ```
421: 
422: The API token needs **Cloudflare Pages - Edit** permission.
423: 
424: ### SSL/TLS Errors on Preview URLs
425: 
426: Make sure:
427: 1. Your wildcard DNS record is **Proxied** (orange cloud)
428: 2. SSL/TLS mode is set to **Full** or **Full (strict)** in Cloudflare dashboard
429: 3. You're using the root domain in `PREVIEW_HOSTNAME` (e.g., `yourdomain.com` not `api.yourdomain.com`)
430: 
431: ### "Could not resolve host" for Preview URLs
432: 
433: - DNS propagation can take a few minutes
434: - Verify the wildcard A record exists: `dig *.yourdomain.com`
435: 
436: ### Container Not Starting
437: 
438: - Ensure Docker Desktop is running when you deploy
439: - Wait 2-3 minutes after first deployment
440: - Check container status: `pnpm exec wrangler containers list`
441: 
442: ### Preview URL Returns 404
443: 
444: The sandbox may have been destroyed. Sandboxes are ephemeral - run the build again to get a new preview URL. The **deployed URL** (Pages) is permanent.
445: 
446: ## Local Development
447: 
448: ```bash
449: # Terminal 1: Start the worker locally
450: pnpm dev
451: 
452: # Terminal 2: Run CLI against local worker
453: NIMBUS_WORKER_URL=http://localhost:8787 npx @dayhaysoos/nimbus start "Build a hello world page"
454: ```
455: 
456: > **Note**: Preview URLs and Pages deployment don't work in local development (they require custom domain routing and Cloudflare infrastructure). The build will complete but URLs won't be accessible.
457: 
458: ## Contributing
459: 
460: Contributions welcome! Please open an issue first to discuss what you'd like to change.
461: 
462: ## License
463: 
464: MIT
465: 
466: ## Acknowledgments
467:

469: - [Anthropic](https://anthropic.com) for Claude
470: - [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai) for the unified LLM API

(End of file - total 470 lines)
</content>

# Nimbus

An open-source CLI that generates and deploys websites using AI. Give it a prompt, get back a permanent URL.

```bash
export NIMBUS_WORKER_URL=https://your-worker.com
npx @dayhaysoos/nimbus start "Build a coffee shop landing page"
```

> **Note**: Nimbus requires a self-hosted worker. See the [Self-Hosting Guide](#self-hosting-guide) below to set up your own instance in ~15 minutes.

**Built with:**
- [Cloudflare Workers](https://workers.cloudflare.com/) - Serverless API
- [Cloudflare Containers/Sandbox SDK](https://developers.cloudflare.com/sandbox/) - Isolated code execution
- [Cloudflare Pages](https://pages.cloudflare.com/) - Permanent hosting
- [Cloudflare D1](https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/) - Job persistence
- [Claude](https://anthropic.com/claude) via [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai/) - Code generation
- [clack](https://github.com/bombshell-dev/clack) - Beautiful CLI prompts

## How It Works

36: function toFlagEntries(value: string | string[] | undefined): string[] {
37:   if (value === undefined) {
38:     return [];
39:   }
40: 
41:   const values = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [value];
42:   return values.map((entry) => entry.trim()).filter(Boolean);

50:   const values = new Map<string, string>();

54:     if (splitIndex <= 0) {
55:       throw new Error(`Invalid --env entry "${entry}". Expected KEY=VALUE.`);
56:     }

-# Nimbus
-
-An open-source CLI that generates and deploys websites using AI. Give it a prompt, get back a permanent URL.
-
-```bash
-export NIMBUS_WORKER_URL=https://your-worker.com
-npx @dayhaysoos/nimbus start "Build a coffee shop landing page"
-```
-
-> **Note**: Nimbus requires a self-hosted worker. See the [Self-Hosting Guide](#self-hosting-guide) below to set up your own instance in ~15 minutes.
-
-**Built with:**
-- [Cloudflare Workers](https://workers.cloudflare.com/) - Serverless API
-- [Cloudflare Containers/Sandbox SDK](https://developers.cloudflare.com/sandbox/) - Isolated code execution
-- [Cloudflare Pages](https://pages.cloudflare.com/) - Permanent hosting
-- [Cloudflare D1](https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/) - Job persistence
-- [Claude](https://anthropic.com/claude) via [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai/) - Code generation
-- [clack](https://github.com/bombshell-dev/clack) - Beautiful CLI prompts
-
-## How It Works
-
-```
-┌─────────┐     ┌──────────────────┐     ┌─────────────┐     ┌─────────────┐
-│   CLI   │────▶│ Cloudflare Worker│────▶│   Claude    │────▶│   Sandbox   │
-│         │     │   (POST /api/jobs)│    │ (OpenRouter)│     │ (Container) │
-└─────────┘     └──────────────────┘     └─────────────┘     └─────────────┘
-                        │                                           │
-                        ▼                                           ▼
-               ┌────────────────┐                        ┌─────────────────────┐
-               │   D1 Database  │                        │   Cloudflare Pages  │
-               │ (Job History)  │                        │  (Permanent URL)    │
-               └────────────────┘                        └─────────────────────┘
-```
-
-1. CLI sends your prompt to the Cloudflare Worker
-2. Worker creates a job record in D1 and asks Claude to generate code
-3. Generated files are written to an isolated Sandbox container
-4. If needed, `npm install` and `npm build` run automatically
-5. A preview server starts (temporary URL for testing)
-6. Files are deployed to Cloudflare Pages (permanent URL)
-
-## CLI Commands
-
-```bash
-# Start a new build (opens model picker)
-nimbus start "Build a portfolio site"
-
-# Start with a specific model (skips picker)
-nimbus start -m anthropic/claude-sonnet-4 "Build a todo app"
-
-# List your job history
-nimbus list
-
-# Watch a specific job's status
-nimbus watch <job-id>
-```
-
-## Self-Hosting Guide
-
-### Prerequisites
-
-- **Node.js** 20+ and **pnpm** 9+
-- **Docker Desktop** running locally (required for Cloudflare Containers)
-- **Cloudflare account** (Workers Paid plan required for Containers)
-- **OpenRouter API key** ([get one here](https://openrouter.ai/keys))
-- **Custom domain** added to Cloudflare (required for preview URLs)
-
-Verify your runtime before starting:
-
-```bash
-node -v
-pnpm -v
-```
-
-### 1. Clone and Install
-
-```bash
-git clone https://github.com/dayhaysoos/nimbus.git
-cd nimbus
-pnpm install
-```
-
-### 2. Create a D1 Database
-
-```bash
-cd packages/worker
-
-# Create the database
-pnpm exec wrangler d1 create nimbus-db
-
-# Note the database_id from the output, you'll need it for wrangler.toml
-```
-
-### 3. Set Up Your Custom Domain
-
-Preview URLs require a custom domain with wildcard DNS. The free `*.workers.dev` domain doesn't support the subdomain pattern needed.
-
-#### Buy/Transfer a Domain
-
-If you don't have one, you can buy a domain directly from Cloudflare:
-1. Go to [Cloudflare Dashboard](https://dash.cloudflare.com/) → **Domain Registration** → **Register Domain**
-2. Or transfer an existing domain to Cloudflare
-
-#### Add Wildcard DNS Record
-
-In the Cloudflare dashboard:
-
-1. Go to your domain → **DNS** → **Records**
-2. Add a new record:
-   - **Type**: `A`
-   - **Name**: `*` (wildcard)
-   - **IPv4 address**: `192.0.2.0`
-   - **Proxy status**: **Proxied** (orange cloud ON)
-   - **TTL**: Auto
-
-> **Note**: `192.0.2.0` is a documentation IP (RFC 5737). Cloudflare recognizes this when proxied and routes traffic to your Worker.
-
-### 4. Create a Cloudflare Pages Project
-
-```bash
-# Create the Pages project for deployments
-pnpm exec wrangler pages project create nimbus
-```
-
-### 5. Configure the Worker
-
-Edit `packages/worker/wrangler.toml`:
-
-```toml
-name = "nimbus-worker"
-main = "src/index.ts"
-compatibility_date = "2025-01-21"
-compatibility_flags = ["nodejs_compat"]
-
-# Enable workers.dev access
-workers_dev = true
-
-# Replace with YOUR domain
-[[routes]]
-pattern = "*.yourdomain.com/*"
-zone_name = "yourdomain.com"
-
-[vars]
-DEFAULT_MODEL = "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4"
-# Replace with YOUR domain (same as zone_name)
-PREVIEW_HOSTNAME = "yourdomain.com"
-# Pages project name for deployments
-PAGES_PROJECT_NAME = "nimbus"
-
-# D1 Database - replace database_id with yours from step 2
-[[d1_databases]]
-binding = "DB"
-database_name = "nimbus-db"
-database_id = "your-database-id-here"
-
-# Sandbox container configuration
-[[containers]]
-class_name = "Sandbox"
-image = "./Dockerfile"
-
-[durable_objects]
-bindings = [{ name = "Sandbox", class_name = "Sandbox" }]
-
-[[migrations]]
-tag = "v1"
-new_sqlite_classes = ["Sandbox"]
-```
-
-**Replace:**
-- `yourdomain.com` with your actual domain (in both places)
-- `database_id` with the ID from step 2
-
-### 6. Run Database Migrations
-
-```bash
-cd packages/worker
-pnpm exec wrangler d1 migrations apply nimbus-db --remote
-```
-
-### 7. Set Secrets
-
-```bash
-cd packages/worker
-
-# OpenRouter API key (for LLM access)
-pnpm exec wrangler secret put OPENROUTER_API_KEY
-# Paste your API key when prompted
-
-# Cloudflare API token (for Pages deployment)
-# Create at: https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens
-# Required permission: Cloudflare Pages - Edit
-pnpm exec wrangler secret put CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
-
-# Cloudflare Account ID (find in dashboard URL or sidebar)
-pnpm exec wrangler secret put CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
-```
-
-### 8. Deploy
-
-Make sure Docker Desktop is running, then:
-
-```bash
-cd packages/worker
-pnpm exec wrangler deploy
-```
-
-First deployment takes 2-3 minutes (builds the container image). You'll see output like:
-
-```
-Uploaded nimbus-worker (8.45 sec)
-Building image nimbus-worker-sandbox:abc123
-...
-Deployed nimbus-worker triggers
-  *.yourdomain.com/* (zone name: yourdomain.com)
-```
-
-**Wait 2-3 minutes** after first deploy for the container to provision before testing.
-
-### 9. Test the Deployment
-
-```bash
-# Health check
-curl https://api.yourdomain.com/health
-
-# Or any subdomain works since you have wildcard routing
-curl https://anything.yourdomain.com/health
-```
-
-### 10. Use the CLI
-
-```bash
-# Option 1: Inline
-NIMBUS_WORKER_URL=https://api.yourdomain.com npx @dayhaysoos/nimbus start "Build a landing page"
-
-# Option 2: Export for session
-export NIMBUS_WORKER_URL=https://api.yourdomain.com
-npx @dayhaysoos/nimbus start "Build a landing page"
-
-# Option 3: Add to shell profile (~/.bashrc, ~/.zshrc, etc.)
-echo 'export NIMBUS_WORKER_URL=https://api.yourdomain.com' >> ~/.zshrc
-```
-
-## Usage
-
-```bash
-# Set your worker URL first
-export NIMBUS_WORKER_URL=https://api.yourdomain.com
-
-# Start a build (interactive model picker)
-npx @dayhaysoos/nimbus start "Build a portfolio site for a photographer"
-
-# Start with a specific model
-npx @dayhaysoos/nimbus start -m anthropic/claude-sonnet-4 "Create a todo app"
-
-# List your job history
-npx @dayhaysoos/nimbus list
-
-# Watch a job's progress
-npx @dayhaysoos/nimbus watch job_abc12345
-```
-
-The CLI will show progress and output URLs:
-
-```
-┌  @dayhaysoos/nimbus
-│
-◇  Job created: job_abc12345
-◇  Generated 3 files
-◇  Build complete
-◇  Preview ready
-│
-●  Preview: https://8080-build-abc123.yourdomain.com/
-│
-◇  Done
-│
-└  Deployed: https://abc123.nimbus.pages.dev
-```
-
-**Two URLs are provided:**
-- **Preview URL** - Temporary, dies when sandbox times out (~10 min idle)
-- **Deployed URL** - Permanent Cloudflare Pages URL
-
-## Project Structure
-
-```
-nimbus/
-├── packages/
-│   ├── cli/                    # @dayhaysoos/nimbus CLI
-│   │   └── src/
-│   │       ├── index.ts        # CLI entry + command router
-│   │       ├── commands/       # start, list, watch commands
-│   │       └── lib/            # API client, model picker, types
-│   └── worker/                 # Cloudflare Worker
-│       ├── src/
-│       │   ├── index.ts        # API routes
-│       │   ├── api/jobs.ts     # Job creation & SSE streaming
-│       │   ├── openrouter.ts   # LLM client
-│       │   ├── sandbox.ts      # Container orchestration
-│       │   ├── lib/
-│       │   │   ├── db.ts       # D1 database operations
-│       │   │   └── deploy/     # Pages deployment
-│       │   └── types.ts        # TypeScript types
-│       ├── migrations/         # D1 database migrations
-│       ├── wrangler.toml       # Cloudflare config
-│       └── Dockerfile          # Sandbox container
-├── package.json                # Workspace root
-└── pnpm-workspace.yaml
-```
-
-## Configuration Options
-
-### Environment Variables (wrangler.toml `[vars]`)
-
-| Variable | Description | Default |
-|----------|-------------|---------|
-| `DEFAULT_MODEL` | OpenRouter model ID | `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4` |
-| `PREVIEW_HOSTNAME` | Domain for preview URLs | (required) |
-| `PAGES_PROJECT_NAME` | Cloudflare Pages project | `nimbus` |
-
-### Secrets (set via `wrangler secret put`)
-
-| Secret | Description |
-|--------|-------------|
-| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Your OpenRouter API key |
-| `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` | Cloudflare API token with Pages Edit permission |
-| `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID` | Your Cloudflare account ID |
-
-### Changing the LLM Model
-
-You can select a model interactively when running `nimbus start`, or specify one with the `-m` flag:
-
-```bash
-nimbus start -m openai/gpt-4o "Build a landing page"
-```
-
-Available models include:
-- `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4` (default)
-- `anthropic/claude-opus-4`
-- `openai/gpt-4o`
-- `openai/gpt-4.1`
-- `google/gemini-2.5-pro`
-- `deepseek/deepseek-r1`
-- `meta-llama/llama-4-maverick`
-
-Or enter any model ID from [OpenRouter Models](https://openrouter.ai/models).
-
-## API Reference
-
-### `POST /api/jobs`
-
-Creates a new job and streams SSE events while generating and building.
-
-**Request:**
-```json
-{
-  "prompt": "Build a landing page for a SaaS product",
-  "model": "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4"
-}
-```
-
-**SSE Events:**
-```
-data: {"type":"job_created","jobId":"job_abc12345"}
-data: {"type":"generating"}
-data: {"type":"generated","fileCount":3}
-data: {"type":"scaffolding"}
-data: {"type":"writing"}
-data: {"type":"installing"}
-data: {"type":"building"}
-data: {"type":"starting"}
-data: {"type":"preview_ready","previewUrl":"https://8080-xxx.yourdomain.com/"}
-data: {"type":"deploying"}
-data: {"type":"complete","previewUrl":"...","deployedUrl":"https://xxx.nimbus.pages.dev"}
-```
-
-### `GET /api/jobs`
-
-Lists all jobs.
-
-**Response:**
-```json
-{
-  "jobs": [
-    {
-      "id": "job_abc12345",
-      "prompt": "Build a landing page",
-      "model": "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4",
-      "status": "completed",
-      "createdAt": "2025-01-22 12:00:00",
-      "deployedUrl": "https://abc123.nimbus.pages.dev"
-    }
-  ]
-}
-```
-
-### `GET /api/jobs/:id`
-
-Gets a specific job's details.
-
-### `GET /health`
-
-Returns `{"status":"ok"}` if the worker is running.
-
-## Troubleshooting
-
-### "OPENROUTER_API_KEY not configured"
-
-```bash
-cd packages/worker
-pnpm exec wrangler secret put OPENROUTER_API_KEY
-```
-
-### Pages deployment fails
-
-Ensure you've set the Cloudflare secrets:
-
-```bash
-pnpm exec wrangler secret put CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
-pnpm exec wrangler secret put CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
-```
-
-The API token needs **Cloudflare Pages - Edit** permission.
-
-### SSL/TLS Errors on Preview URLs
-
-Make sure:
-1. Your wildcard DNS record is **Proxied** (orange cloud)
-2. SSL/TLS mode is set to **Full** or **Full (strict)** in Cloudflare dashboard
-3. You're using the root domain in `PREVIEW_HOSTNAME` (e.g., `yourdomain.com` not `api.yourdomain.com`)
-
-### "Could not resolve host" for Preview URLs
-
-- DNS propagation can take a few minutes
-- Verify the wildcard A record exists: `dig *.yourdomain.com`
-
-### Container Not Starting
-
-- Ensure Docker Desktop is running when you deploy
-- Wait 2-3 minutes after first deployment
-- Check container status: `pnpm exec wrangler containers list`
-
-### Preview URL Returns 404
-
-The sandbox may have been destroyed. Sandboxes are ephemeral - run the build again to get a new preview URL. The **deployed URL** (Pages) is permanent.
-
-## Local Development
-
-```bash
-# Terminal 1: Start the worker locally
-pnpm dev
-
-# Terminal 2: Run CLI against local worker
-NIMBUS_WORKER_URL=http://localhost:8787 npx @dayhaysoos/nimbus start "Build a hello world page"
-```
-
-> **Note**: Preview URLs and Pages deployment don't work in local development (they require custom domain routing and Cloudflare infrastructure). The build will complete but URLs won't be accessible.
-
-## Contributing
-
-Contributions welcome! Please open an issue first to discuss what you'd like to change.
-
-## License
-
-MIT
-
-## Acknowledgments
-
-- [Cloudflare](https://cloudflare.com) for Workers, Containers, Pages, and D1
-- [Anthropic](https://anthropic.com) for Claude
-- [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai) for the unified LLM API

# Nimbus

An open-source CLI that generates and deploys websites using AI. Give it a prompt, get back a permanent URL.

```bash
export NIMBUS_WORKER_URL=https://your-worker.com
npx @dayhaysoos/nimbus start "Build a coffee shop landing page"
```

> **Note**: Nimbus requires a self-hosted worker. See the [Self-Hosting Guide](#self-hosting-guide) below to set up your own instance in ~15 minutes.

**Built with:**
- [Cloudflare Workers](https://workers.cloudflare.com/) - Serverless API
- [Cloudflare Containers/Sandbox SDK](https://developers.cloudflare.com/sandbox/) - Isolated code execution
- [Cloudflare Pages](https://pages.cloudflare.com/) - Permanent hosting
- [Cloudflare D1](https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/) - Job persistence
- [Claude](https://anthropic.com/claude) via [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai/) - Code generation
- [clack](https://github.com/bombshell-dev/clack) - Beautiful CLI prompts

## How It Works

```
┌─────────┐     ┌──────────────────┐     ┌─────────────┐     ┌─────────────┐
│   CLI   │────▶│ Cloudflare Worker│────▶│   Claude    │────▶│   Sandbox   │
│         │     │   (POST /api/jobs)│    │ (OpenRouter)│     │ (Container) │
└─────────┘     └──────────────────┘     └─────────────┘     └─────────────┘
                        │                                           │
                        ▼                                           ▼
               ┌────────────────┐                        ┌─────────────────────┐
               │   D1 Database  │                        │   Cloudflare Pages  │
               │ (Job History)  │                        │  (Permanent URL)    │
               └────────────────┘                        └─────────────────────┘
```

1. CLI sends your prompt to the Cloudflare Worker
2. Worker creates a job record in D1 and asks Claude to generate code
3. Generated files are written to an isolated Sandbox container
4. If needed, `npm install` and `npm build` run automatically
5. A preview server starts (temporary URL for testing)
6. Files are deployed to Cloudflare Pages (permanent URL)

## CLI Commands

```bash
# Start a new build (opens model picker)
nimbus start "Build a portfolio site"

# Start with a specific model (skips picker)
nimbus start -m anthropic/claude-sonnet-4 "Build a todo app"

# List your job history
nimbus list

# Watch a specific job's status
nimbus watch <job-id>
```

## Self-Hosting Guide

### Prerequisites

- **Node.js** 20+ and **pnpm** 9+
- **Docker Desktop** running locally (required for Cloudflare Containers)
- **Cloudflare account** (Workers Paid plan required for Containers)
- **OpenRouter API key** ([get one here](https://openrouter.ai/keys))
- **Custom domain** added to Cloudflare (required for preview URLs)

Verify your runtime before starting:

```bash
node -v
pnpm -v
```

### 1. Clone and Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/dayhaysoos/nimbus.git
cd nimbus
pnpm install
```

### 2. Create a D1 Database

```bash
cd packages/worker

# Create the database
pnpm exec wrangler d1 create nimbus-db

# Note the database_id from the output, you'll need it for wrangler.toml
```

### 3. Set Up Your Custom Domain

Preview URLs require a custom domain with wildcard DNS. The free `*.workers.dev` domain doesn't support the subdomain pattern needed.

#### Buy/Transfer a Domain

If you don't have one, you can buy a domain directly from Cloudflare:
1. Go to [Cloudflare Dashboard](https://dash.cloudflare.com/) → **Domain Registration** → **Register Domain**
2. Or transfer an existing domain to Cloudflare

#### Add Wildcard DNS Record

In the Cloudflare dashboard:

1. Go to your domain → **DNS** → **Records**
2. Add a new record:
   - **Type**: `A`
   - **Name**: `*` (wildcard)
   - **IPv4 address**: `192.0.2.0`
   - **Proxy status**: **Proxied** (orange cloud ON)
   - **TTL**: Auto

> **Note**: `192.0.2.0` is a documentation IP (RFC 5737). Cloudflare recognizes this when proxied and routes traffic to your Worker.

### 4. Create a Cloudflare Pages Project

```bash
# Create the Pages project for deployments
pnpm exec wrangler pages project create nimbus
```

### 5. Configure the Worker

Edit `packages/worker/wrangler.toml`:

```toml
name = "nimbus-worker"
main = "src/index.ts"
compatibility_date = "2025-01-21"
compatibility_flags = ["nodejs_compat"]

# Enable workers.dev access
workers_dev = true

# Replace with YOUR domain
[[routes]]
pattern = "*.yourdomain.com/*"
zone_name = "yourdomain.com"

[vars]
DEFAULT_MODEL = "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4"
# Replace with YOUR domain (same as zone_name)
PREVIEW_HOSTNAME = "yourdomain.com"
# Pages project name for deployments
PAGES_PROJECT_NAME = "nimbus"

# D1 Database - replace database_id with yours from step 2
[[d1_databases]]
binding = "DB"
database_name = "nimbus-db"
database_id = "your-database-id-here"

# Sandbox container configuration
[[containers]]
class_name = "Sandbox"
image = "./Dockerfile"

[durable_objects]
bindings = [{ name = "Sandbox", class_name = "Sandbox" }]

[[migrations]]
tag = "v1"
new_sqlite_classes = ["Sandbox"]
```

**Replace:**
- `yourdomain.com` with your actual domain (in both places)
- `database_id` with the ID from step 2

### 6. Run Database Migrations

```bash
cd packages/worker
pnpm exec wrangler d1 migrations apply nimbus-db --remote
```

### 7. Set Secrets

```bash
cd packages/worker

# OpenRouter API key (for LLM access)
pnpm exec wrangler secret put OPENROUTER_API_KEY
# Paste your API key when prompted

# Cloudflare API token (for Pages deployment)
# Create at: https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens
# Required permission: Cloudflare Pages - Edit
pnpm exec wrangler secret put CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN

# Cloudflare Account ID (find in dashboard URL or sidebar)
pnpm exec wrangler secret put CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
```

### 8. Deploy

Make sure Docker Desktop is running, then:

```bash
cd packages/worker
pnpm exec wrangler deploy
```

First deployment takes 2-3 minutes (builds the container image). You'll see output like:

```
Uploaded nimbus-worker (8.45 sec)
Building image nimbus-worker-sandbox:abc123
...
Deployed nimbus-worker triggers
  *.yourdomain.com/* (zone name: yourdomain.com)
```

**Wait 2-3 minutes** after first deploy for the container to provision before testing.

### 9. Test the Deployment

```bash
# Health check
curl https://api.yourdomain.com/health

# Or any subdomain works since you have wildcard routing
curl https://anything.yourdomain.com/health
```

### 10. Use the CLI

```bash
# Option 1: Inline
NIMBUS_WORKER_URL=https://api.yourdomain.com npx @dayhaysoos/nimbus start "Build a landing page"

# Option 2: Export for session
export NIMBUS_WORKER_URL=https://api.yourdomain.com
npx @dayhaysoos/nimbus start "Build a landing page"

# Option 3: Add to shell profile (~/.bashrc, ~/.zshrc, etc.)
echo 'export NIMBUS_WORKER_URL=https://api.yourdomain.com' >> ~/.zshrc
```

## Usage

```bash
# Set your worker URL first
export NIMBUS_WORKER_URL=https://api.yourdomain.com

# Start a build (interactive model picker)
npx @dayhaysoos/nimbus start "Build a portfolio site for a photographer"

# Start with a specific model
npx @dayhaysoos/nimbus start -m anthropic/claude-sonnet-4 "Create a todo app"

# List your job history
npx @dayhaysoos/nimbus list

# Watch a job's progress
npx @dayhaysoos/nimbus watch job_abc12345
```

The CLI will show progress and output URLs:

```
┌  @dayhaysoos/nimbus
│
◇  Job created: job_abc12345
◇  Generated 3 files
◇  Build complete
◇  Preview ready
│
●  Preview: https://8080-build-abc123.yourdomain.com/
│
◇  Done
│
└  Deployed: https://abc123.nimbus.pages.dev
```

**Two URLs are provided:**
- **Preview URL** - Temporary, dies when sandbox times out (~10 min idle)
- **Deployed URL** - Permanent Cloudflare Pages URL

## Project Structure

```
nimbus/
├── packages/
│   ├── cli/                    # @dayhaysoos/nimbus CLI
│   │   └── src/
│   │       ├── index.ts        # CLI entry + command router
│   │       ├── commands/       # start, list, watch commands
│   │       └── lib/            # API client, model picker, types
│   └── worker/                 # Cloudflare Worker
│       ├── src/
│       │   ├── index.ts        # API routes
│       │   ├── api/jobs.ts     # Job creation & SSE streaming
│       │   ├── openrouter.ts   # LLM client
│       │   ├── sandbox.ts      # Container orchestration
│       │   ├── lib/
│       │   │   ├── db.ts       # D1 database operations
│       │   │   └── deploy/     # Pages deployment
│       │   └── types.ts        # TypeScript types
│       ├── migrations/         # D1 database migrations
│       ├── wrangler.toml       # Cloudflare config
│       └── Dockerfile          # Sandbox container
├── package.json                # Workspace root
└── pnpm-workspace.yaml
```

## Configuration Options

### Environment Variables (wrangler.toml `[vars]`)

| Variable | Description | Default |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| `DEFAULT_MODEL` | OpenRouter model ID | `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4` |
| `PREVIEW_HOSTNAME` | Domain for preview URLs | (required) |
| `PAGES_PROJECT_NAME` | Cloudflare Pages project | `nimbus` |

### Secrets (set via `wrangler secret put`)

| Secret | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Your OpenRouter API key |
| `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` | Cloudflare API token with Pages Edit permission |
| `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID` | Your Cloudflare account ID |

### Changing the LLM Model

You can select a model interactively when running `nimbus start`, or specify one with the `-m` flag:

```bash
nimbus start -m openai/gpt-4o "Build a landing page"
```

Available models include:
- `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4` (default)
- `anthropic/claude-opus-4`
- `openai/gpt-4o`
- `openai/gpt-4.1`
- `google/gemini-2.5-pro`
- `deepseek/deepseek-r1`
- `meta-llama/llama-4-maverick`

Or enter any model ID from [OpenRouter Models](https://openrouter.ai/models).

## API Reference

### `POST /api/jobs`

Creates a new job and streams SSE events while generating and building.

**Request:**
```json
{
  "prompt": "Build a landing page for a SaaS product",
  "model": "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4"
}
```

**SSE Events:**
```
data: {"type":"job_created","jobId":"job_abc12345"}
data: {"type":"generating"}
data: {"type":"generated","fileCount":3}
data: {"type":"scaffolding"}
data: {"type":"writing"}
data: {"type":"installing"}
data: {"type":"building"}
data: {"type":"starting"}
data: {"type":"preview_ready","previewUrl":"https://8080-xxx.yourdomain.com/"}
data: {"type":"deploying"}
data: {"type":"complete","previewUrl":"...","deployedUrl":"https://xxx.nimbus.pages.dev"}
```

### `GET /api/jobs`

Lists all jobs.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "jobs": [
    {
      "id": "job_abc12345",
      "prompt": "Build a landing page",
      "model": "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4",
      "status": "completed",
      "createdAt": "2025-01-22 12:00:00",
      "deployedUrl": "https://abc123.nimbus.pages.dev"
    }
  ]
}
```

### `GET /api/jobs/:id`

Gets a specific job's details.

### `GET /health`

Returns `{"status":"ok"}` if the worker is running.

## Troubleshooting

### "OPENROUTER_API_KEY not configured"

```bash
cd packages/worker
pnpm exec wrangler secret put OPENROUTER_API_KEY
```

### Pages deployment fails

Ensure you've set the Cloudflare secrets:

```bash
pnpm exec wrangler secret put CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
pnpm exec wrangler secret put CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
```

The API token needs **Cloudflare Pages - Edit** permission.

### SSL/TLS Errors on Preview URLs

Make sure:
1. Your wildcard DNS record is **Proxied** (orange cloud)
2. SSL/TLS mode is set to **Full** or **Full (strict)** in Cloudflare dashboard
3. You're using the root domain in `PREVIEW_HOSTNAME` (e.g., `yourdomain.com` not `api.yourdomain.com`)

### "Could not resolve host" for Preview URLs

- DNS propagation can take a few minutes
- Verify the wildcard A record exists: `dig *.yourdomain.com`

### Container Not Starting

- Ensure Docker Desktop is running when you deploy
- Wait 2-3 minutes after first deployment
- Check container status: `pnpm exec wrangler containers list`

### Preview URL Returns 404

The sandbox may have been destroyed. Sandboxes are ephemeral - run the build again to get a new preview URL. The **deployed URL** (Pages) is permanent.

## Local Development

```bash
# Terminal 1: Start the worker locally
pnpm dev

# Terminal 2: Run CLI against local worker
NIMBUS_WORKER_URL=http://localhost:8787 npx @dayhaysoos/nimbus start "Build a hello world page"
```

> **Note**: Preview URLs and Pages deployment don't work in local development (they require custom domain routing and Cloudflare infrastructure). The build will complete but URLs won't be accessible.

## Contributing

Contributions welcome! Please open an issue first to discuss what you'd like to change.

- [Anthropic](https://anthropic.com) for Claude
- [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai) for the unified LLM API

+# Nimbus
+
+Nimbus is currently an experiment and active work in progress.
+
+This README is intentionally minimal while the product direction settles.
+
+## Current Focus
+
+The current priority is checkpoint-driven execution:
+
+- Resolve a checkpoint/commit to source
+- Upload a source bundle to the worker
+- Queue a background checkpoint job
+- Run install/build/test/lint inside Cloudflare Sandbox
+- Persist job status and replayable events
+
+## What Works Today
+
+- `deploy checkpoint` dry-run resolution and preflight
+- Live checkpoint job creation with `--no-dry-run`
+- Queue-backed worker processing (`CHECKPOINT_JOBS_QUEUE`)
+- Deterministic installs with lockfile enforcement
+- `watch` polling for queued/running/completed/failed jobs
+
+## Known Limits (Expected Right Now)
+
+- No persistent preview/deployed URL for checkpoint jobs yet
+- Checkpoint live SSE stream output in CLI is not complete yet
+- Checkpoint install support is currently for npm/bun lockfiles (pnpm/yarn are rejected)
+
+## Quick Start (Dev)
+
+From repo root:
+
+```bash
+source ~/.bash_profile
+pnpm install
+```
+
+Set up infra (safe to re-run):
+
+```bash
+pnpm wrangler queues create nimbus-checkpoint-jobs
+pnpm wrangler d1 migrations apply nimbus-db --remote
+```
+
+Deploy worker:
+
+```bash
+pnpm run deploy
+```
+
+Point CLI to your worker URL:
+
+```bash
+export NIMBUS_WORKER_URL="https://<your-worker>.workers.dev"
+```
+
+Create and watch a live checkpoint job:
+
+```bash
+pnpm cli -- deploy checkpoint HEAD --project-root packages/worker --no-dry-run
+pnpm cli -- watch <job_id>
+```
+
+## Common Commands
+
+```bash
+# Run worker tests
+pnpm --filter @dayhaysoos/nimbus-worker test
+
+# Run CLI tests
+pnpm --filter @dayhaysoos/nimbus test
+
+# Run worker locally
+pnpm dev

# Nimbus

Nimbus is currently an experiment and active work in progress.

This README is intentionally minimal while the product direction settles.

Entire docs: [docs.entire.io/introduction](https://docs.entire.io/introduction)

## Current Focus

The current priority is launching Entire checkpoints in a sandbox execution pipeline:

- Resolve an Entire checkpoint (or commit) to source
- Upload a source bundle to the worker
- Queue a background checkpoint job
- Run install/build/test/lint inside Cloudflare Sandbox
- Persist job status and replayable events

## What Works Today

- `deploy checkpoint` dry-run resolution and preflight
- Live checkpoint job creation with `--no-dry-run`
- Queue-backed worker processing (`CHECKPOINT_JOBS_QUEUE`)
- Deterministic installs with lockfile enforcement
- `watch` polling for queued/running/completed/failed jobs

Entire checkpoint notes:

- Checkpoint IDs from commit trailers (for example `checkpoint:be1b10a00b44`) resolve and run.
- The worker executes install/build/test/lint in Cloudflare Sandbox for that checkpoint source.

## Known Limits (Expected Right Now)

- No persistent preview/deployed URL for checkpoint jobs yet
- Checkpoint live SSE stream output in CLI is not complete yet
- Checkpoint install support is currently for npm/bun lockfiles (pnpm/yarn are rejected)

## Quick Start (Dev)

From repo root:

```bash
source ~/.bash_profile
pnpm install
```

Set up infra (safe to re-run):

```bash
pnpm wrangler queues create nimbus-checkpoint-jobs
pnpm wrangler d1 migrations apply nimbus-db --remote
```

Deploy worker:

```bash
pnpm run deploy
```

Point CLI to your worker URL:

```bash
export NIMBUS_WORKER_URL="https://<your-worker>.workers.dev"
```

Create and watch a live checkpoint job:

```bash
pnpm cli -- deploy checkpoint checkpoint:be1b10a00b44 --project-root packages/worker --no-dry-run
pnpm cli -- watch <job_id>
```

You can also target any commit-ish:

```bash
pnpm cli -- deploy checkpoint HEAD --project-root packages/worker --no-dry-run
```

## Common Commands

```bash
# Run worker tests
pnpm --filter @dayhaysoos/nimbus-worker test

# Run CLI tests
pnpm --filter @dayhaysoos/nimbus test

# Run worker locally
pnpm dev
```

## CLI Surface (Current)

```bash
nimbus start <prompt>
nimbus list
nimbus watch <job-id>
nimbus deploy checkpoint <checkpoint-id-or-commit-ish>
```

Important checkpoint flags:

- `--project-root <path>`: required for many monorepos
- `--no-dry-run`: actually creates/queues a live job
- `--no-tests`, `--no-lint`: skip validation steps in metadata
- `--env-file`, `--env KEY=VALUE`: pass environment inputs for preflight

## Notes

- Node 20+ is required.
- Nimbus currently targets self-hosted worker usage.
- If you hit `404` on `/api/checkpoint/jobs`, deploy the latest worker code.

## License

gh pr create --base main --head v2-agentic --title "feat: add Entire checkpoint queue execution pipeline" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## Summary
- Pivot Nimbus toward launching Entire checkpoints in a queue-backed Cloudflare sandbox pipeline instead of prompt-first generation as the primary path.
- Add end-to-end checkpoint flow: CLI resolution + source bundle upload -> worker job creation -> queue consumer execution (install/build/test/lint) -> persisted job events and replay.
- Hardened the pipeline through multiple review/fix cycles and live infra debugging so checkpoint runs now complete successfully in production worker infra.

## How We Got Here (Detailed Timeline)
1. **Foundation / runtime controls (`87f5d72`, `52cd39c`)**
   - Added Entire wiring and reset worker schema baseline.
   - Introduced runtime flags/state-machine foundations used by the worker runtime path.

2. **Checkpoint source intake (`20ddbc3`)**
   - Implemented checkpoint source metadata fields and migrations.
   - Added CLI checkpoint input parsing/resolution with commit trailer support and monorepo project-root disambiguation.
   - Added dry-run preflight for env templates and checkpoint metadata packaging.
   - Added worker checkpoint job creation endpoint and source bundle storage groundwork.

3. **Async queue execution + replayable events (`dc96d85`)**
   - Added `CHECKPOINT_JOBS_QUEUE` producer/consumer bindings and queue message schema.
   - Added checkpoint runner to:
     - claim queued jobs,
     - hydrate source from R2,
     - unpack in sandbox,
     - detect lockfile/package manager,
     - run install/build/test/lint,
     - persist terminal status.
   - Added job events persistence and replay/snapshot support in events API (including replay cursor behavior).

4. **Hardening fixes after repeated review passes (`5e9c7c3`, `a97cd8f`, `afdcba6`)**
   - Fixed queue retry semantics and duplicate-delivery behavior:
     - no-op for already-running/already-claimed deliveries,
     - reset stale timing/error metadata on retry/claim,
     - avoid accidental status corruption for non-checkpoint jobs.
   - Fixed create-job enqueue cleanup paths and failure handling.
   - Made failure/completion event persistence best-effort so status transitions remain authoritative.
   - Fixed CLI source archival root bug (archive now rooted at repo top-level so project-roots like `packages/worker` resolve in sandbox).
   - Fixed deterministic install behavior in sandbox:
     - include dev dependencies for npm checkpoint installs so tooling (`tsc`) exists when running tests,
     - normalized worker `package-lock.json` to avoid workspace/pnpm-linked lock artifacts that break clean sandbox installs.

5. **Live deployment and production-like verification**
   - Deployed worker with queue producer/consumer bindings and confirmed `/api/checkpoint/jobs` route is live (moved from 404 to handler responses).
   - Ran live checkpoint jobs through CLI + watch, iterated on failures, and reached successful completion (`job_a1002brz`), confirming end-to-end viability.

6. **Docs reset (`9652877`)**
   - Rewrote README to reflect the current experimental status and checkpoint-first focus.
   - Added Entire docs reference and minimal, accurate dev instructions.

## Major Changes Included
- **CLI**
  - New `deploy checkpoint` command path and options parsing (`--project-root`, `--no-dry-run`, env inputs).
  - Checkpoint resolver, git/archive/env/deploy-request modules with tests.
  - Checkpoint API request support and command help updates.
- **Worker**
  - New checkpoint job API surface and queue consumer path.
  - New checkpoint runner/planner/queue modules.
  - D1 helpers for claim/update/event sequencing and checkpoint metadata mapping.
  - Job events replay improvements (`Last-Event-ID`/snapshot behavior).
  - Wrangler queue and R2 bindings plus migration updates.
- **Tests**
  - Added broad test coverage across CLI checkpoint utilities and worker checkpoint pipeline behavior, including edge-case regressions discovered during review.

## Validation Performed
- Local test/typecheck runs used throughout implementation:
  - `pnpm --filter @dayhaysoos/nimbus-worker test`
  - `pnpm --filter @dayhaysoos/nimbus-worker exec tsc -p tsconfig.json`
  - `pnpm --filter @dayhaysoos/nimbus test`
- Live infra validation after deploy:
  - Verified queue bindings and endpoint availability.
  - Executed real checkpoint deploy + watch flow to terminal success.

## Current Scope / Known Limits
- This PR validates checkpoint execution in sandbox (install/build/test/lint) and job/event lifecycle.
- Persistent preview/deployed URL output for checkpoint jobs is still out of scope in this slice.
- CLI live SSE rendering for checkpoint flow is still intentionally minimal.

## Commit List in This PR
- `87f5d72` set up entire
- `52cd39c` feat: reset schema baseline and add runtime controls
- `20ddbc3` feat: add checkpoint source intake flow
- `dc96d85` feat: add queue-backed checkpoint execution and replayable job events
- `5e9c7c3` fix: archive checkpoint source from repo root and sync worker lockfile
- `a97cd8f` fix: include dev deps for npm checkpoint installs
- `afdcba6` fix: normalize worker lockfile for checkpoint sandbox installs
- `9652877` update readme
EOF

+# Entire Checkpoint Deployment - Next Steps
+
+## Why this doc exists
+
+We just merged the checkpoint execution milestone to `main`.
+
+Current behavior is:
+
+- resolve Entire checkpoint/commit
+- upload checkpoint source bundle
+- queue and run sandbox install/build/test/lint
+- mark job completed/failed with persisted job events
+
+What is **not** done yet: deploying a built app artifact to a user-facing URL from this checkpoint flow.
+
+This document tracks the immediate plan so we do not lose context.
+
+## Decision
+
+Create a fixture app first, then implement checkpoint deployment.
+
+Reason: we need a deterministic, low-noise target to validate the deploy path. Testing against the Nimbus infra repo itself introduces avoidable monorepo/tooling noise.
+
+## Goal (next milestone)
+
+Run:
+
+`pnpm cli -- deploy checkpoint <fixture-checkpoint> --project-root examples/entire-fixture-web --no-dry-run`
+
+and end with:
+
+- `status=completed`
+- non-empty `deployed_url`
+- CLI `watch` prints the deployed URL
+
+## Plan
+
+### 1) Add fixture app (`examples/entire-fixture-web`)
+
+Requirements:
+
+- small static app
+- deterministic lockfile
+- scripts: `build`, `test`, `lint`
+- predictable output directory (`dist/`)
+

# Entire Checkpoint Deployment - Next Steps

## Why this doc exists

We just merged the checkpoint execution milestone to `main`.

Current behavior is:

- resolve Entire checkpoint/commit
- upload checkpoint source bundle
- queue and run sandbox install/build/test/lint
- mark job completed/failed with persisted job events

What is **not** done yet: deploying a built app artifact to a user-facing URL from this checkpoint flow.

This document tracks the immediate plan so we do not lose context.

## Decision

Create a fixture app first, then implement checkpoint deployment.

Reason: we need a deterministic, low-noise target to validate the deploy path. Testing against the Nimbus infra repo itself introduces avoidable monorepo/tooling noise.

## Goal (next milestone)

Run:

`pnpm cli -- deploy checkpoint <fixture-checkpoint> --project-root examples/entire-fixture-web --no-dry-run`

and end with:

- `status=completed`
- non-empty `deployed_url`
- CLI `watch` prints the deployed URL

## Plan

### 1) Add fixture app (`examples/entire-fixture-web`)

Requirements:

- small static app
- deterministic lockfile
- scripts: `build`, `test`, `lint`
- predictable output directory (`dist/`)

Suggested minimal stack:

- Vite + TypeScript (or simple static npm scripts)
- keep dependencies small and stable

Deliverables:

- app files in `examples/entire-fixture-web`
- committed lockfile and passing local scripts

### 2) Implement checkpoint deploy phase in worker

After successful build/validation in checkpoint runner:

- transition phase to `deploying`
- publish built artifact (existing Pages deploy path if reusable)
- persist `deployed_url` on job row
- append deploy/completion events

Expected files (likely):

- `packages/worker/src/lib/checkpoint-runner.ts`
- `packages/worker/src/lib/db.ts`
- `packages/worker/src/api/job-events.ts`
- worker tests for new deploy behavior

### 3) Update CLI output for checkpoint jobs

- `watch` should show deployed URL when present
- remove stale wording that implies checkpoint output is always non-deployable
- keep behavior explicit when URL is unavailable

Expected files (likely):

- `packages/cli/src/commands/watch.ts`
- `packages/cli/src/commands/deploy/checkpoint.ts`

### 4) Add E2E smoke path

At minimum:

- run a live checkpoint deploy against fixture app
- verify terminal completed state and non-empty `deployed_url`
- document exact repro commands in README or this doc

## Acceptance criteria

1. Fixture app checkpoint run succeeds in sandbox (install/build/test/lint).
2. Same run publishes app and returns a real deployed URL.
3. CLI `watch` prints that URL clearly.
4. Worker + CLI tests cover key success/failure paths.
5. README remains accurate to actual behavior.

## Out of scope for this milestone

- persistent preview sandbox URLs
- full live SSE checkpoint event rendering polish
- broad multi-framework fixture matrix

## Quick command checklist (when implementing)

```bash
# tests
pnpm --filter @dayhaysoos/nimbus-worker test
pnpm --filter @dayhaysoos/nimbus test

# deploy worker
pnpm --filter @dayhaysoos/nimbus-worker run deploy

# live checkpoint run
pnpm cli -- deploy checkpoint <checkpoint-or-commit> --project-root examples/entire-fixture-web --no-dry-run
pnpm cli -- watch <job_id>
```
